subject: English
passage: To understand how ancient Mayan communities organized their agricultural practices, archaeologist Bintu Sankoh frequently examines stone carvings found at excavation sites throughout Guatemala. ______ she studies ceramic fragments from the same period, as they often contain residues that reveal which crops were cultivated in specific regions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. "Additionally" logically signals that the ceramic analysis discussed in this sentence is an additional part of the archaeological research discussed in the previous sentence. That is, to research how ancient Mayans organized agriculture, the archaeologist studies ceramic fragments in addition to examining stone carvings.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because "instead" illogically signals that the ceramic analysis discussed in this sentence is an alternative to the archaeological research discussed in the previous sentence. Rather, the ceramic analysis is an additional part of that research.
